candidate.answerReason: The equal central angles are in the same circle, so their corresponding chords are equal and CD=AB=6.

methods.label: Equal central angles give equal chords
methods.explanation: In the same circle, equal central angles subtend equal chords, so \(CD=AB=6\).
methods.levelReason: Directly applies the Grade 9 equal-chord relationship.

methods.label: Compare triangles by SAS
methods.explanation: Compare \(\triangle AOB\) and \(\triangle COD\): their sides from \(O\) are radii of the same circle, so \(OA=OC\) and \(OB=OD\). Their included angles are also equal. Thus the triangles are congruent by SAS, and their corresponding chord sides are equal. Therefore, \(CD=AB=6\).
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 8 triangle congruence and equal radii, providing a lower-prerequisite derivation of the chord equality.
